name: Landing Page — Product positioning and demo booking
description: A prospective restaurant client lands on the marketing site, views USPs and pricing, and fills out the demo booking form.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the landing home page at /
Scroll through the primary USP sections highlighting 520ms landing animation and loginless cross-outlet recognition
Click the Book a Demo call-to-action button
Verify the demo request form displays fields for Restaurant Name, Outlet Count, and Contact Phone/Email
